import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        int ans = 0;
        Arrays.sort(a);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int p = i + 1;
            while (p < n && Math.abs(a[i] - a[p]) <= T) {
                p++;
            }
            ans = Math.max(ans, p - i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
